name: PDF Letter
author: Fabian Bitter
description: Renders a structured letter as a print ready PDF laid out to DIN 5008, so the recipient block sits in the window of a DL or C6/C5 envelope. Works offline with no external API, with sender profiles, English and German fixed texts and signature images.

PDF_LETTER_OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory for generated letter PDFs, defaults to the system temp directory

PDF_LETTER_FONT_DIR.description: Additional font directory searched when a font family is resolved by name
